Package com.nexuslink.core.history

Class HistoryStore

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.history.HistoryStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class HistoryStore extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Persistent request history backed by SQLite with an FTS5 full-text index. Recent entries are mirrored in the history-recent Caffeine region so the common "show latest" path never touches disk.

Thread-safe for the app's usage pattern (single connection, short statements).
